audience: webshop owners who check orders, stock, discount codes and newsletter sign-ups in MyOnlineStore

useCases.title: Count orders for a period and their totals
useCases.text: Count the orders for a date range, then list them with status, date and payment status. Open one order to read its price block.

useCases.title: Find articles that changed or have stock
useCases.text: List the articles changed in a date range, with name, SKU, price and stock. Count the articles, or open one article to read its details.

useCases.title: Review the category tree and its articles
useCases.text: List the categories as a tree. Open one category, then list the articles that belong to it.

useCases.title: Check active discount codes
useCases.text: List the discount codes, with their validity dates and active flag. Open one code to read its values and minimum order rules.

useCases.title: Count newsletter sign-ups in a period
useCases.text: Count the newsletter subscribers for a date range. Then list them with their activation state and dates.

useCases.title: Check the store and its shipping methods
useCases.text: Read the shop details to check the connection and the currency. List the shipping methods with the countries each one serves.
